sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Seasons fundamentally work the same as the PvP game mode, but on separate character and dedicated servers in a time-limited, modifier influenced gameplay cycle with exclusive content and rewards only obtainable in the respective season.

sections.heading: Season 1: KORD BREACH
sections.text: Season 1 started on August 3, 2026 and ends on December 7, 2026.

sections.heading: Differences from other game modes
sections.text:
- Special [KORD BREACH] questline is available starting with Prapor's quest Uninvited Guests - Part 1.
- Insurance is not available.
- Hideout zones do not require items to be found in raid.
- Black Division soldiers can be rarely encountered roaming on Ground Zero (Level 21+), Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov, and Woods.
- Raiders on The Lab have been substituted with Black Division.
- The crafting time of all Hideout crafts is reduced by half.
- EXP is gained 25% faster.

sections.heading: Leagues
sections.text:
After the first raid, the player is placed into a group of 50 players of their rank. Each group has its own leaderboard. The player's position on the leaderboard is determined by the amount of experience they earned during the week. Experience earned from eliminating PMCs, Scavs, and Bosses, completing tasks, examining items, and so on counts toward your League progress. Experience earned in Arena doesn't count toward Leagues, but will still be awarded to your character.

The more experience the player earns, the higher they place on the leaderboard. At the end of each week, the top 25 players will rank up, 15 will remain at their current rank, and 10 will be demoted. The first time a player reaches a new rank, they receive its corresponding rewards. These rewards are permanent, even if the player's rank is later reduced.

When a Seasonal character's progress is reset, the current Rank and all experience earned during the week will be reset.
